suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Trigger and action work
suggested_services.example: The main story: a pistol that jams. Only the $40 diagnosis is promised. Gene's written estimate is OK'd before any work, the part is ordered, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up, with the same photo ID.

suggested_services.name: Pistol cleaning
suggested_services.example: A $50 pistol cleaning from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off. Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Trigger and action work
suggested_services.example: The same repair, with the bill texted when it is ready, so Alex can pay before pick-up. The firearm is still handed back only to Alex, with the ID.

suggested_services.name: Refinish
suggested_services.example: A $250 refinish: a $125 deposit at booking, credited to the bill, and the $125 rest at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Collection appraisal

suggested_services.name: Estate appraisal
suggested_services.example: An estate collection, priced at the visit after counting the firearms. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee, and Rosie texts the bill after DONE. The executor is there with the papers.

before_times: the kind of firearm (pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun) and what it needs (cleaning, a repair, a scope, a refinish, an appraisal)
whether it's an item regulated under the National Firearms Act (a suppressor, a short barrel, fully automatic): it decides whether the shop can take it
for an appraisal: how many firearms, and the town
after_time: what's wrong, in the customer's words (it jams, a part broke)
secure_page_only: the make, model and serial number (for the shop's federal record)
the customer's name, address and date of birth as on a government photo ID (the ID itself is checked at the counter)
for a regulated (NFA) item: the owner's approved registration paper, shown at drop-off
the appraisal address, and photos of the firearm
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult who owns the firearm or may lawfully have it; 21 or older (the example shop's rule, and any age rule federal or state rules set for returning a firearm); only the person who leaves a firearm may pick it up; an estate's firearms are brought or appraised with the executor and the papers; a minor never books

stop.words: someone threatening to hurt themselves or others, or someone hurt by a firearm right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. If you're thinking of hurting yourself, call or text 988.

safety_and_stop_words.go_on: no for refused requests; yes for handling notes

steps.name: Firearm details form
steps.when: on the secure page, before drop-off
steps.result: done: it books; not done: filled at the counter

steps.name: Photo ID
steps.result: matches: checked in or handed back; doesn't match: nothing is taken in or handed over

steps.name: Registration paper for a regulated (NFA) item
steps.result: shown: taken in, if the shop has the status; missing: not taken in

steps.name: Signed written estimate
steps.when: before any work beyond the diagnosis; before a refinish's deposit
steps.result: signed: work starts; not signed: returned as it came

prep: Unload it, case it, and leave the ammunition at home
Bring the magazines and any parts
For a regulated item, bring its approved registration paper

staff.skills: cleaning, general repair, action and trigger work, optics, barrel work, refinish, appraisal, regulated (NFA) work only with the status
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license; the federal license is the business's, and its responsible persons are named on it; each person who handles customers' firearms has a background check (the shop's rule, and where the state's rules require it)
staff.supervision: an apprentice works only under a gunsmith; only the license holder or a named person hands a firearm back and closes the record
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs any regulated (NFA) work, any refinish, any estimate over $300, and any unusual request (refused if it isn't lawful)
staff.stand_in: bench work names nobody: any gunsmith with the skill may do it; an appraisal names the appraiser and moves only with the owner's yes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult who owns the firearm or may lawfully have it; 21 or older (the example shop's rule, and any age rule federal or state rules set for returning a firearm); only the person who leaves a firearm may pick it up; an estate's firearms are brought or appraised with the executor and the papers; a minor never books

visit.check_in: at the counter: the check-in code and a government photo ID; the gunsmith confirms it's unloaded, logs the make, model and serial (in the shop's federal record when it stays overnight, as federal rules require), photos its condition, and gives a claim ticket
visit.done: DONE at pick-up, when the ID matches and the shop's record is closed
visit.changes_at_visit: anything found at the bench is priced and texted; nothing extra without a yes; a safety defect is written on the secure page, and the firearm is never handed back as safe

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: a federal firearms license that covers gunsmithing wherever the shop takes firearms in to work on them (a generic federal switch; work that federal rules count as manufacturing needs the matching license); any state or local dealer or gunsmith license where the state's rules require one; work on items regulated under the federal National Firearms Act (suppressors, short-barreled rifles and shotguns, machine guns) only where the shop's federal license and its special tax status allow it; a business registration
license.who: the business: the federal license names its premises and its responsible persons
ask: the federal firearms license number (shown only as 'checked' once it is)
any state or local license, where the state's rules require one
the address on the federal license (work is done there)
whether the shop holds the federal status for regulated (NFA) items
license.insurance: liability insurance and coverage for customers' firearms while the shop has them, as the business says; shown only once proof is sent

never_in_a_text: a firearm's make, model and serial number, the customer's ID details, registration papers and anything about who may lawfully have a firearm never go in a text: only on the secure page; READY and pick-up texts say 'your item'; the owner may pick a plain display name
